FN-TBGIP55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 304
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2026
Senate Bill 304 as introduced could decrease business license fee receipts to municipalities by
an undetermined amount by requiring municipalities to allow certain businesses to exclude the
gross receipts used to calculate the amount of a business license paid in a municipality in which
the business is not located from being included in the calculation for a municipal business
license in the municipality in which the business is located.
Page 1

FN-TBGIP55-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 304
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2026
Senate Bill 304 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government could
decrease business license fee receipts to municipalities by an undetermined amount by requiring
municipalities to allow certain businesses to exclude the gross receipts used to calculate the
amount of a business license paid in a municipality in which the business is not located from
being included in the calculation for a municipal business license in the municipality in which
the business is located.
This bill could also further decrease business license fee receipts to municipalities by an
undetermined amount by providing that a municipality may not require certain businesses to
obtain a municipal business license to work on county projects located on county property or
county-maintained infrastructure.
